title: Revealing a new target: Celastrol alleviates pulmonary fibrosis by inhibiting PCAF.
authors: Wang, Libo; Lin, Fei; Liu, Junwei; Jia, Zhichao; Zhu, Mingyang; Liu, Yuan; Li, Yongheng; Yang, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Celastrol通过抑制PCAF乙酰化NF-kappaB缓解肺纤维化，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF) is a serious interstitial lung disease characterized by declining pulmonary function but with few effective drugs and limited therapies. New anti-fibrosis drugs and targets are required to combat PF. Celastrol, a triterpenoids component isolated from Tripterygium wilfordii, has many kinds of pharmacological and physiological activities, such as anti-fibrosis, however its potential mechanisms and direct targets remain unclear. In this study, network pharmacology analysis, biotin-affinity pulldown assay, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation were used and found celastrol directly target P300/CBP-associating factor (PCAF), a histone acetyltransferase (HAT). Mechanistic investigation shown that celastrol inhibited the acetylation of NF-kappaB by suppressing PCAF. Strikingly, we found that celastrol suppressed TGF-beta induced epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) characterized by the decrease in migration and invasion in vitro and protect against bleomycin (BLM) induced mouse model of PF in vivo. Taken together, these findings indicate that PCAF is a new potential target for the treatment of PF and celastrol is a promising clinical candidate for the therapy of PF by target EMT mediated via PCAF/ NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 肺纤维化（PF）是一种严重的间质性肺疾病，其特征为肺功能下降，但有效药物和治疗方法有限。需要新的抗纤维化药物和靶点来对抗PF。雷公藤红素（Celastrol）是从雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii）中分离得到的三萜类成分，具有多种药理和生理活性，如抗纤维化，但其潜在机制和直接靶点仍不清楚。在本研究中，采用网络药理学分析、生物素亲和下拉实验、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，发现雷公藤红素直接靶向P300/CBP相关因子（PCAF），一种组蛋白乙酰转移酶（HAT）。机制研究表明，雷公藤红素通过抑制PCAF来抑制NF-kappaB的乙酰化。值得注意的是，我们发现雷公藤红素抑制了TGF-beta诱导的上皮-间质转化（EMT），表现为体外迁移和侵袭能力下降，并在体内保护博来霉素（BLM）诱导的小鼠PF模型。综上所述，这些发现表明PCAF是治疗PF的新潜在靶点，而雷公藤红素通过靶向PCAF/NF-kappaB通路介导的EMT，是治疗PF的有前景的临床候选药物。
